name: Asana Projects
description: Browse Asana workspaces, projects, and tasks, summarize blockers, and create tasks with approval.
long_description: Connect Row-Bot to Asana with a Personal Access Token. Read side: list workspaces and projects, list and search tasks, view one task's detail, and summarize a project's open blockers by due status and assignment. Write side: create a task inside a project. The create tool is approval-gated, so Row-Bot asks the user to confirm before anything is written to Asana. Reads never require approval.

default_count.label: Default number of results
default_count.description: How many workspaces, projects, or tasks to return per list or search (1-30).

default_workspace.label: Default workspace GID
default_workspace.description: Optional Asana workspace GID used for task search and as the default when listing projects. Run 'list_workspaces' to find it.

access_token.label: Asana Personal Access Token
access_token.description: A Personal Access Token from Asana (Settings -> Apps -> Developer apps -> Personal access tokens).
